turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, someone reversed into my parked car and drove off. I'm really upset, the car is practically new. My policy number is OS-405068.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this, Imran, I can imagine how worrying that is. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Imran Rahman.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Imran, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I should tell you I lost my job recently, so money is really tight at the moment.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Anyway, back to your policy.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had an accident in your car and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It was yesterday around half five, on the ring road near the retail park. A van pulled out and hit the side of my car.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thankfully nobody was hurt, but the passenger door and wing are badly dented and it's not really drivable.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm the registration number of the vehicle?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's LY15 DFK.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why does it take so long? Can't you just speed it up for me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will my claim definitely be approved, do you think?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't promise an outcome as the claims team assesses every claim, but this is the kind of event your policy is designed for.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, any settlement will be subject to the policy excess and the indemnity limit, and we may pursue subrogation against the other party's insurer.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. What happens next is that we'll acknowledge your claim within 24 hours, and the claims team will assess it within 10 working days of receiving all your supporting documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Imran. I've logged your claim under reference CLM-73112, and the claims team will contact you to take things forward.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Imran. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
